title: How to survive in the jungle
short: How to survive in the jungle
text: Tropical jungles are some of the most beautiful places on Earth, but they can be dangerous if you get lost. Survival experts agree on a few basic rules that could save your life.

The first rule is: you must not panic. Sit down, breathe and think. If you are on a path, you should stay near it, because rescuers will look there first. Leave signs, like broken branches or stones in a line, to show where you have been.

Water is more important than food. In the jungle it rains a lot, so you should collect rainwater with big leaves. You must not drink water from rivers without boiling it, because it can contain parasites. A person can survive weeks without food, but only a few days without water.

At night the jungle is full of insects. You should not sleep on the ground. Build a simple bed with branches, and cover yourself with leaves. Also, you should not touch brightly colored animals: in nature, bright colors often mean danger.
Finally, if you find a river, follow it downstream. Rivers usually lead to villages. Experts say that the most important tool is not a knife: it is a calm mind.

grammar.title: Grammar: should and must
grammar.rule: Use should for advice and must for strong obligation. Must not means it is prohibited or very dangerous.
rows: You should stay near the path.
You should not sleep on the ground.
